requirements.evidenceBasis: DRY23-P2 Main Agent fallback contamination; DRY24 worker contracts
requirements.requirement: Every worker agent MUST have a declared owned scope (files/directories) and forbidden scope. No agent may write outside owned scope.
All spawned agents MUST use fork_context:false. No agent may inherit full conversation context.

requirements.evidenceBasis: H14 native agent tracking; H17 agent lifecycle resolution
requirements.requirement: Every agent MUST have: spawn receipt, progress events, close receipt. Agent lifecycle MUST be tracked in AGENT_REGISTRY.json and AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl.

requirements.evidenceBasis: H13-D session rotation handoff; DRY24 worker contracts
requirements.requirement: Every worker MUST produce a handoff artifact with SHA256. Handoff MUST include: output file list with hashes, completed contract checklist, transcript reference.

requirements.evidenceBasis: DRY23-P1/P2 Main Agent fallback detection and repair
requirements.requirement: Main Agent MUST NOT write worker implementation scope. If spawn fails, failure MUST be classified and replacement spawned, not silently absorbed.

requirements.evidenceBasis: DRY24 integrator role; H15 CI enforcement
requirements.requirement: Integrator MUST be sole merge owner of integration hub. Builders MUST NOT modify integration hub or other builder scopes.

requirements.evidenceBasis: H15 integrator-verifier boundary; DRY24 verifier modules
requirements.requirement: Verifier MUST be readonly. Verifier MUST NOT modify implementation, registry, or contracts.
Every phase MUST have a verifier script producing machine-readable JSON with per-gate PASS/FAIL. No manual PASS-only, no expectedClass-only, no generic FAIL.

requirements.evidenceBasis: H18 context-compression-policy; H17 session rotation policy
requirements.requirement: Compressed summary is NOT evidence. All closure decisions MUST be based on verifier JSON, transcripts, and registry entries.
Multi-agent architecture MUST demonstrate benefit at large-project scale (50+ features, 5+ independent modules). Benefit at small/medium scale is nice-to-have, not requirement.
Agent count MUST be proportional to project independence, not project size alone. More agents than independent work packages is overkill.
Agent coordination overhead (spawn time, contract generation, handoff verification) MUST be measured and compared against sequential baseline.
